handback.title: A renamed autopilot label starts autopilot
handback.summary: Autopilot wakes only for a label named autopilot, so a repo that renames the label never starts it.
handback.user_story: Owners who rename the autopilot label in settings can still switch an issue on by adding that label.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a person adds the repo's renamed autopilot label to an issue, its planner starts.
acceptance_criteria.words: The autopilot workflow still triggers on the fixed label name, so a renamed label never starts it.

edge_cases.case: After a rename, a label still called autopilot starts nothing.
